To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) there is a variety of methods for ontology learning; (ii) there are three main groups of techniques used in the methods: linguistics, statistics and machine learning; (iii) the tools are focused on different aspects of the ontology and they can be grouped into three main groups: tools for learning new relations, tools for assisting the building up of taxonomies and tools for learning new terms; (iv) the methods and tools have not been compared in a comprehensive manner; and

the most common techniques used by the methods and tools for building ontologies from text are the linguistic techniques and the machine learning techniques, while the statistical techniques are less common.

the main techniques for ontology learning are: linguistics, statistics, and machine learning; that the main elements to be learned are concepts, relations, and instances; and that the main sources of information are texts and ontologies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of ontology learning methods and tools, and with the analysis of their main techniques and characteristics.
the state-of-the-art in ontology learning from texts, with the aim of providing a useful overview of the methods and tools available and their relationships with each other
the state of the art of ontology learning from texts and the methods and tools that have been developed in the past 20 years.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ontology learning from texts is an open field, which still has to be explored and developed.
the methods and the tools are complementary, and the use of one or the other is dependent of the ontology development task.
there is not a method or a tool that can be considered as the best one, but that each method or tool has its own strengths and weaknesses.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the methods and the tools for ontology learning are still in their initial phase, and there are still many open problems to be addressed.
the tools for learning relations are the most developed, followed by the assisting tools for building taxonomies, and finally by the tools for learning concepts.
, in the field of ontology learning from text, the main focus is on learning relations between concepts and the main techniques are based on machine learning.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the methods and tools for building ontologies from text can be classified according to the main technique used and the main goal of each tool.
, although several methods and tools exist for ontology learning, there is no single method or tool that can be used in all the situations.
there is a lack of tools which are able to learn the whole ontology from texts.
